hero.label: Services
hero.headline: Less to sit through. More that sticks.
hero.intro: Three ways to work together, each scoped so you know what you're getting, how long it takes, and what it costs before we start.

items.name: Training Audit
items.summary: A focused review of an existing course or program: what to keep, cut, and restructure, with a prioritized redesign plan.
items.description: A focused review of an existing course or program. You get a clear report on what to keep, cut, and restructure, with a prioritized redesign plan your team can act on.
items.best_for: Teams with a course that people start but don't finish, or finish without changing anything.

items.name: Program Redesign
items.summary: Heavy courses rebuilt into efficient, focused learning: microlearning, audio formats, and reflection-based modules, with measurement built in.
items.description: We rebuild heavy courses into efficient, focused learning experiences, such as microlearning, audio formats, and reflection-based modules, with measurement built in from day one.
deliverables: Build in your LMS or platform
items.best_for: Organizations ready to replace a long, low-impact program with something people will actually use.

items.name: Leader & Executive Learning
items.summary: Learning products for time-poor leaders who won't sit through traditional courses. Short, credible, and built for real schedules.
items.description: Learning products for time-poor leaders who won't sit through traditional courses. Short, credible, and built to fit into real schedules, modeled on the approach behind Fast Focus.
deliverables: Audio and text formats for on-the-go use
items.best_for: L&D and transformation teams who need senior leaders engaged, not just enrolled.

extras.title: AI-enabled learning systems
extras.text: Prompt pipelines, content governance, and mastery tracking for AI-powered learning products.

extras.title: Certification program design
extras.text: Technical certifications coordinated across SMEs, vendors, and regions, from structure to launch.

items.question: Do you work with our existing LMS?
items.answer: Yes. I design for the platform you already have. [Add platforms you've worked in, such as 360Learning.]

items.question: What if we don't want to cut content?
items.answer: Nothing essential gets lost. Deeper material can live one click away, the way Fast Focus linked leaders back to full courses.

items.question: Can we start small?
items.answer: Yes. Most clients begin with a Training Audit, then decide whether to redesign.

band.headline: Not sure which fits? Start with a 20-minute call.
